question: Which revilers are explicitly forbidden from receiving this Kaula teaching?
premises: The teaching must not be given to a reviler of Shiva.
It must not be given to a slanderer of Kula Bhairava.
The prohibition is addressed to the goddess.
inference: Revilers of Shiva and slanderers of Kula Bhairava are excluded from receiving the teaching.
plain_english: O Goddess, not to one who reviles Shiva, nor to one who slanders Kula Bhairava.
